premium.title: Elevate Your Modding Experience
premium.subtitle: Unlock advanced synchronization tools, secure cloud backup storage, and effortless preset sharing.
premium.feature_cloud_desc: Safely backup and restore your game configurations, player saves, and mod settings to our secure cloud storage.
premium.feature_cloud_detail_1: Up to **10 GB** of dedicated storage space.
premium.feature_cloud_detail_2: Allows large configuration databases and save files up to **100 MB** each.
premium.feature_cloud_detail_3: Smart filtering automatically excludes heavy assemblies/DLLs and assets to optimize space.
premium.feature_cloud_detail_4: Seamless restore with a single click in the Desktop Client.
premium.feature_presets_desc: Share your active mod layout and exact version configurations with friends or the community in one click.
premium.feature_presets_detail_1: Generate unique, shareable preset links directly from your Installed tab.
premium.feature_presets_detail_2: Others can open the preset in their Desktop Client to synchronize instantly. (Importing and syncing is free for everyone)
premium.feature_presets_detail_3: Automatically downloads missing mods and sets the active/inactive states to match yours.
premium.feature_presets_detail_4: Perfect for multiplayer matches, speedruns, and content creators.
premium.step_1_desc: Join our membership tier on Patreon to support the development of modlist.org.
premium.step_2_desc: Log into this website via Discord. The server will auto-detect your Patron status and grant Premium badges instantly.
premium.step_3_desc: Go to your Profile page, click "Link Desktop App", and authorize the client in one click. No copy-pasting required!
profile.cloud_desc: Automatically backup and restore game settings and configuration files. Large assemblies/dlls and heavy assetbundles are excluded to optimize space.
profile.presets_desc: Share your active mod list via link presets so others can sync to your exact setup instantly.
profile.become_patron_help: Support us on Patreon for just $1/month to unlock these Premium features!
profile.integration_desc: Use this token to link your desktop client and unlock premium features. Keep this token secret.
profile.not_logged_in_desc: Please log in with Discord first to view your profile.
